question: What is the correct order of metallic character of the following metals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 3**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Option 3** correctly represents the order of **metallic character: Mg 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **metallic character** is directly related to the atomic size and ionization energy of the elements.
 
• **Cesium (Cs)**, being at the bottom of Group 1, has the largest atomic size and the lowest ionization energy, making it the most metallic.
 
• **Barium (Ba)** is in Group 2 and has a larger atomic size and lower ionization energy than Sodium (Na) and Magnesium (Mg), making it more metallic than both.
 
• **Sodium (Na)** is in Group 1 but is above Cesium, making it less metallic than Cesium and Barium but more metallic than Magnesium.
 
• **Magnesium (Mg)** is in Group 2 and has the smallest atomic size and highest ionization energy among the given elements, making it the least metallic.
